attempts.summary: Configured split-horizon DNS: node1 (VyOS, lan-a router, PowerDNS Recursor) resolves app.internal to node3's lan-a address 10.10.1.10; node2 (OPNsense, lan-b router, Unbound) resolves app.internal to node4's lan-b address 10.10.2.10. Topology was discovered via STP bridge-id matching (node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1=transit, node1 eth2<->node3 ens7=lan-a, node2 vtnet2<->node4 ens7=lan-b), statically addressed (dhcp:false segments), and DNS configured via VyOS static-host-mapping + dns forwarding, and OPNsense unboundplus host override + firewall pass rule. All 4 nodes were sequentially restarted per the mandatory protocol, boot identity change confirmed on each, and DNS/service health verified post-recovery.
